examples.title: Norway — ByggesaksBIM (DiBK), hard requirements
examples.description: 8 specifications, one for each requirement the DiBK P13 eByggesak report marks Obligatorisk (ARK, Forprosjekt). Our own reading of that report, written 2026-10-26; DiBK has not published it. Data types are the IFC4 ones where DiBK gives none, and the building type is checked for presence only.

examples.title: Norway — ByggesaksBIM (DiBK), warnings
examples.description: 24 specifications for the 27 items the DiBK P13 eByggesak report marks Advarsel (not all can be written in IDS). Our own reading of that report, written 2026-10-26; DiBK has not published it. IDS has no severity, so treat every failure here as a warning. Data types are the IFC4 ones where DiBK gives none.
